    {"name": "defect_or_failure_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Concrete failure taxonomy adds strong analytical value for negative reviews.     {"name": "recommendation_stance", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "Directly relevant facet; distinguishes explicit vs implicit stance beyond the label. Samples well-grounded (Skip it=warns_against, Bicycle Thieves=explicitly_recommends)."}

No confabulated specific facts observed."
